subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so which syntax, dependency, and config shape should be accepted?
rationale: The request is valuable and fits web frontend ergonomics, but it changes untrusted chat rendering and likely introduces a dependency/config contract, so automation should not choose the product and security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one current KaTeX or MathJax PR to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, compatibility tests, and real Control UI proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow to explicit math syntax
options.body: Accept math rendering only for explicit delimiters or markdown-stage parsing that avoids global `$...$` reinterpretation of existing prose.

options.title: Defer out of core
options.body: Keep Control UI markdown unchanged for now and revisit only if maintainers approve the dependency/security tradeoff or a plugin/API path becomes practical.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one current KaTeX or MathJax PR to completion with dependency approval, sanitizer review, compatibility tests, and real Control UI proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He has original chat markdown renderer history plus adjacent Control UI product, dependency, and config ownership signals.
